Railways Warn Passengers Against Loud Music, Potential Jail Time

Indian Railways has issued a warning to passengers against playing loud music or making loud calls on trains, stating that violations could lead to legal action, including a potential jail term of up to six months and a fine of Rs 1,000. The announcement aims to address disturbances caused by loud audio and video content played on speakers, which can disrupt other passengers' journeys.
